_doc: Arcade/handling tuning for SledPhysics. Lower assist numbers = more simulation, higher = more arcade.

suspension._reboundMult: extra damping while the spring extends – stops the rear kicking back up after bumps/landings

slip._doc: lateral force rises with slip angle to a peak, then falls to slideRatio × peak while sliding; below lowSpeedGrip m/s sideways creep is simply stopped

lean._doc: Side lean steers the sled by itself in soft snow (leanSteerPowder rad of equivalent steer) and adds ski bite when leaning into a turn; forward lean loads the skis (more steering, more nose-dig in powder), back lean adds track traction and lifts the nose

treeAssist._doc: Arcade handling only: tree dodge for the ridden sled (trunks also get frictionless bark): trunks within clearance m of the path covered in the next lookSeconds (max maxLook m) get a sideways nudge of up to maxAccel m/s², plus a little yaw (yawPerDv) so it reads as a swerve.

assist._doc: landingAssist torques the sled toward the ground normal as it comes down (fades with distance and with active flip/spin input)

bog._doc: Snow drag fades toward crawlFactor near standstill so an overloaded sled bogs down and crawls instead of stopping dead; wheelspin in soft snow digs the track in by digPerSlip × sinkDepth

rails._doc: Applied in proportion to a sled's 'rails' value (sleds.json, 0..1). tractionFloor: track grip coefficient it can never drop below, on any surface (also removes wheelspin, so no trenching); launchBoost: extra thrust cap as a fraction of weight; brakeBoost: extra braking; latGripMult/latGripFloor: sideways grip multiplier and minimum coefficient; trackLatScale: share of that sideways grip the track keeps (low = the tail rotates freely and the guide holds the path); peakTighten: how much sooner grip builds with slip angle (and it never slides off the peak); turnG: the fixed lateral g (any surface) that caps the turn rate; maxYawRate: rad/s ceiling on it at low speed (rails steer by rate command: full lock = that turn rate, half lock = half); yawAssistBoost: stronger steering assist; highSpeedSteer: extra steering lock kept at speed; steerResponse: faster steering input; guideRate: 1/s at which sideways velocity is bled off so the sled follows its nose; rollBoost/pitchStiffness/pitchDamping: self-levelling on the ground; landingBoost: stronger landing assist in the air; speedCapBoost: how far the surface speed cap is lifted.
